data.description:
Checks performed to examine or locate the creature bearing this symbol, as well as Accuracy Checks and Magic Checks for attacks and offensive spells (@ICON[offensive]) that include the creature bearing this symbol among their targets, gain a +2 bonus. If an attack or spell targets multiple creatures bearing this symbol, the effect is cumulative.

You Spend: @LOSS[2 ip]
Target Gain: @EFFECT[pfu-symbol-of-truth]
